hero.title: Our History & Vision
hero.description: FingerPrinter was born from a desire to democratize the understanding of online privacy and system intelligence through simple and powerful tools.

why.title: Why FingerPrinter?
why.p1: In an age where every digital interaction leaves a trace, understanding what your browser reveals about you has become essential. FingerPrinter uses heuristic analysis techniques to extract metadata that few users suspect.
why.p2: Our mission is to provide a complete audit of your digital identity, from physical hardware (GPU, CPU) to software and network layers, while offering tools to export this data for security analysis purposes.
